clusters.headline: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
clusters.summary: About half of the 2,500 recorded deaths from Ebola happened in the last 20 days, the WHO says.

clusters.headline: US imposes 50 percent tariffs on $20bn in Canadian goods after talks fail
clusters.summary: Canadian prime minister says country will match tariffs 'dollar for dollar' after failure to secure US trade agreement.

clusters.headline: Sudan: To Permanent Representatives of Member and Observer States of the United Nations (UN) Human Rights Council (Geneva, Switzerland)
clusters.summary: [HRW] Sudan: Extend the Fact-Finding Mission's mandate and ensure adequate resources for investigations and reporting

clusters.headline: Social media fueled hopes of reaching Ceuta. DW meets Moroccans caught between no future at home and the risks ahead.
clusters.summary: The Moroccan city of Fnideq is next to Spanish-controlled Ceuta. In Fnideq, would-be migrants dream of crossing to a better life, even as locals who witnessed recent mass migration surges say it's way too risky.

clusters.headline: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
clusters.summary: Seven World Central Kitchen workers were killed in the Israeli strike on their convoy in 2024.

clusters.headline: Ethiopia: Ethiopia, U.S. Agree to Establish Comprehensive Strategic Cooperation in Defense, Security
clusters.summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia and the United States have agreed to establish comprehensive strategic cooperation in defense and security.

clusters.headline: A dinner that's also a play at Michelin-starred Nouri, where chef Ivan Brehm turns actor as you eat
clusters.summary: Restaurant Nouri and Checkpoint Theatre have joined forces to create what is probably Singapore's first true fusion of fine dining and theatre. The 10-course, three-hour experience pairs each course with a chapter from chef Ivan Brehm's personal journey.

clusters.headline: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'Vulture King' is fighting to reverse the trend
clusters.summary: Some see them as sinister or hunt them for ritual use but these birds play a vital role in nature's cycle.

clusters.headline: Pre-peak discount issue that affected 210,000 journeys a day on Aug 20 and 21 fixed: SimplyGo
clusters.summary: The discount was not activated for SimplyGo EZ-Link and bank card transactions on both days because of a configuration error, the company said.

clusters.headline: Somalia: Hundreds of Health and Nutrition Facilities Closed As Somalia's Child Crisis Deepens
clusters.summary: [Unicef] Mogadishu/Nairobi -- This is a summary of what was said by UNICEF Spokesperson, James Elder, to whom quoted text may be attributed - at today's press briefing at the Palais des Nations in Geneva

clusters.headline: South Korea container ship sets sail to test Arctic commercial route amid Western concerns
clusters.summary: President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority for South Korea, a shipping powerhouse.

clusters.headline: Africa: Inaugural Africa Business Investment Summit Convenes 27-28 August in Washington DC
clusters.summary: [Africa Business Investment Summit] Africa's business leaders will convene in Washington D.C., for the inaugural Africa Business Investment Summit (ABIS) 2026, taking place at MGM National Harbor 27-28 August 2026 as the centerpiece of Millennium Excellence Awards America.
